name: symbol-align
description: Vertically aligns punctuation symbols such as =, : and => inside your code.

symbolAlign.enabled.description: Align the symbols of a document when it is formatted.

symbolAlign.symbols.description: Symbols to align, for example ["=", ":"]. An empty list aligns the symbols that are conventional for the language.

symbolAlign.language.description: Language profile used to align the document. Use "auto" to detect it from the language of the document.

symbolAlign.scope.description: How the lines are grouped before they are aligned. "block" aligns the lines of a blank-line separated block, "indent" keeps every nesting level on its own column, "file" aligns every line of the document.

symbolAlign.declarations.description: Align the declaration columns of typed languages — the modifiers, the type and the name of a declaration.

symbolAlign.declarationAnchor.description: Which edge of a declaration cell is aligned. "start" aligns the content start of every cell, "end" pads the type on its left so the type ends line up.

symbolAlign.maxDeclarationPad.description: Largest column difference that still joins a declaration column. A type outside the window keeps its column instead of pushing every name.

symbolAlign.groups.description: Groups of alternative tokens that share one alignment column, for example [["MY_STATE1", "MY_STATE2"]]. Group members are aligned before the symbols and are removed from the symbol list.
